title: Keep Recipe Search
description: Tired of having your recipe search cleared everytime you close your inventory/crafting? Me too!
body:
Tired of having your recipe search cleared everytime you close your inventory/crafting? Me too!
 
This mod saves your recipe search so you can quickly craft the item you want to without having to search for it again. So if you are a person like me that constantly uses the recipe book, it's an ideal mod to have.
